name: mind-diary
description: Read enabled Minds and preserve discussed lasting knowledge by their topics, with optional Personal Mind configuration through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Use Personal and shared Minds by their topics.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the Mind Diary UAT pilot with OAuth. Site modes determine read/write access; descriptions determine topics for automatic use. Personal Mind without a description is used only when you ask. Ask Codex to configure its optional topics with the separate personal:configure permission. When Personal and the ordinary writable Mind both match, Codex reads and saves independently in both, checks duplicates and reports partial outcomes. Current access, immutable history and revision concurrency remain enforced. The bundled macOS companion supports one explicitly selected regular file.
